pr_json.title: fix(scan): detect upload handlers by consumed parameter list

diff:
diff --git a/src/upload_scan.py b/src/upload_scan.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3ed9b92fba0a40f818179f52e881e27a51ebb8c1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/upload_scan.py
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+"""Classify handler lines that consume untrusted file parameters."""
+
+
+def is_upload_handler(line):
+    """True when the handler consumes an untrusted file-like parameter."""
+    params = line.split("(", 1)[-1].rsplit(")", 1)[0]
+    names = [part.strip().lower() for part in params.split(",")]
+    return any(
+        name in ("file", "upload", "attachment", "stream") for name in names
+    )
diff --git a/tests/test_upload_scan.py b/tests/test_upload_scan.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..badf0a39548903c8788310ceaa76b840952e5ce7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_upload_scan.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+from src.upload_scan import is_upload_handler
+
+
+def test_upload_handler_is_detected():
+    assert is_upload_handler("def save_blob(file):")
+
+
+def test_trigger_in_the_declared_name_is_not_enough():
+    assert not is_upload_handler("def upload_metrics():")
+
+
+def test_plain_handler_is_not_detected():
+    assert not is_upload_handler("def health_check():")
